identitySignals: OUSD's 2021 agenda items piggyback on Toshiba contracts for copiers/printers and managed print solutions made through OMNIA Partners; OMNIA's Toshiba supplier page offers managed print solutions and links to business.toshiba.com, the Toshiba America Business Solutions website
Toshiba America Business Solutions, Inc. sells multifunction printers/copiers and Managed Print Services, matching OUSD's 'Technology' contracts for copiers, printers and managed print
A later OUSD consent item (26-1464) names Toshiba America Business Solutions as the piggyback vendor on an OMNIA Partners contract
research.notes: Agenda text says only 'Toshiba' with no city. Entity chosen is Toshiba America Business Solutions, Inc. based on the OMNIA supplier page linking to its website and a later OUSD item naming it. The OMNIA page itself does not name the legal entity. No general email on the cited contact page, so email omitted; registry IDs not verified.

profile.summary: Toshiba America Business Solutions is the U.S. office printing and digital solutions business of Toshiba. It makes and sells multifunction printers (copiers), laser printers, scanners and digital signage, and provides managed print services and document management to businesses and public agencies, including schools.

sources.title: Contact Us - Toshiba America Business Solutions

review.notes: OUSD's Toshiba piggyback items for copiers and managed print match Toshiba America Business Solutions, Inc. (OMNIA page links to business.toshiba.com; a 2026 OUSD item names the entity). Legal name, address, phone and product/service claims are confirmed on the cited Toshiba pages; the summary is neutral.
